newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Health Management Associates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Health Management Associates.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said it initiated coverage of Health Management Associates Inc as a market performer.
-- set a 12-month target price at $26 a share.
-- sees earnings growing at an annual rate of 20 percent for the next three years on annual revenue growth of 14 percent, assuming no additional acquisitions.
-- If the company maintains its acquisition pace, earnings and revenus growth could increase further.
-- Health Management lost 1/8 to 24 in afternoon trading.
